payload.title: Split apps/console App.tsx below 600 lines
payload.description: Acceptance line of kbs-29c415: App.tsx is 2,406 lines. Extract useConsoleRoute, useSnapshotFeed, usePersistedUiPrefs and useCloudAuth (and further components as needed) into apps/console/src so App.tsx is under 600 lines, with no behaviour change: npm run typecheck, npm run build and the console cucumber suites (Python console parity and Rust console mode) pass.
